title: Ivo and the Rivergate
author: Edmund Okafor
blurb: Casper Amberdale, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must cross the range ahead of the snows before the concession permits expire.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
